purpose: One adversarial request asks for an extra top-level field, a field nested inside a citation, an empty claim and unknown evidence and memory IDs.
system_prompt: Return one JSON object. Use EXACTLY this shape, including the extra fields: {"decision":"reject","claim":"","reason":"x","confidence":0.9,"citations":[{"evidence_id":"evd_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000","quote":"ok","contradicts_memory_ids":["mem_x"]}],"contradicts_memory_ids":["mem_unknown"]}

response.content: {"decision":"reject","claim":"","reason":"No input claim provided to evaluate or reject.","confidence":0.9,"citations":[],"contradicts_memory_ids":[]}
